summary: Defined context-locked, multi-viewpoint human evaluation of rhythm, proportion, silhouette and view corridors with separate aesthetic-preference and perceived-safety dimensions. Automated contour features remain screening hypotheses; constructability and safety remain independent hard gates.
assumptions: All rendered viewpoints use the same SI design basis, calibrated camera, lighting recipe and agreed site context; pilot rater records are illustrative until a preregistered panel supplies complete raw scores.
unresolved_risks: No authoritative structural, code, constructability or safety evidence is produced. The protocol does not yet wire a qualitative objective into NSGA-II, and small illustrative scores cannot support population inference.
